        "outputs": ["Availability confirmation or conflict flag"]
      },

      },
      {
        "id": "A5",

      {

      },

        "outputs": ["Calendar entry", "Transport assignment"]

      {
        "id": "A12",
        "name": "Confirm revised arrangements with partner",

        "system": "Family messaging app",
        "inputs": ["Proposed revised arrangements"],
        "outputs": ["Confirmed revised arrangements or decision to withdraw"]

      {
        "id": "A13",
        "name": "Update shared family calendar and transport assignment",

        "system": "Shared family calendar app",
        "inputs": ["Confirmed revised arrangements"],
        "outputs": ["Updated calendar entry", "Updated transport assignment"]
      }
    ],
    "decisions": [
      {
        "id": "D1",
        "condition": "Does the activity schedule fit the family calendar and meet participation requirements?",
        "branches": [
          "Yes — proceed to check household and transport caregiver availability (A3)",
          "No — discard activity and return to search (A1)"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "D2",
        "condition": "Are household and transport caregiver available for the activity schedule?",
        "branches": [
          "Yes — proceed to cost comparison (A4)",
          "No — discard activity and return to search (A1)"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "D3",
        "condition": "Does the activity cost fall within the household spending limit?",
        "branches": [
          "Yes — proceed to confirm participation decision with partner (A5)",
          "No — discard activity and return to search (A1)"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "D4",
        "condition": "Do both caregivers agree to proceed with enrollment?",
        "branches": [
          "Yes — submit enrollment registration (A6)",
          "No — discard activity; optionally return to search (A1)"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "D5",

      }

  "automation_opportunities": [
